glosses: Any large herbivorous ungulate mammal native to Africa and Asia of the family Rhinocerotidae, with thick, gray skin and one or two horns on their snouts.

glosses: A member of the superfamily Rhinocerotoidea, including hornless members of the extinct genus Paraceratherium.
